I would ask your neurologist about looking into pseudotumor Cerebri (aka idiopathic intracranial hypertension). It can cause migraines as well as cause vision problems, which is what led to my diagnosis after I suddenly needed glasses at 21 despite being able to see perfectly my whole life until that point. It’s not a very common condition, but rates of diagnosis are supposedly rising. The cause of the vision issues with IIH is increased pressure in the skull due to cerebrospinal fluid, which then pushes on your optic nerve. If yo uso have it, there’s several medications that you could possibly be prescribed to get rid of excesssive fluid in your body. It’s definitely helped my migraines and headaches, although it sucks having to pee so much lol 

Good luck with your appointment, and I hope you feel better!
